name: gravity-pulse
description: Phone-style real-time battery status bar monitor for Antigravity AI Quota with point-to-point precision, burn-rate pace estimation, trend sparklines, multi-model pinning, and live server tracking.

commands.title: GravityPulse: Switch Displayed Model in Status Bar
GravityPulse: Refresh Live Quota from Antigravity Server

gravitypulse.pinnedModels.description: List of AI models to display simultaneously in the status bar.

gravitypulse.displayStyle.description: Status bar battery display style (e.g. $(zap) G3.7F [███████░] 94.1%). Fully styled with Carbon Product Icons.

gravitypulse.precision.description: Point-to-point status precision: Single decimal (e.g. 94.1%) or exact integer (e.g. 94%).

gravitypulse.pollingIntervalSeconds.description: Polling interval in seconds to fetch latest quota from local Antigravity Language Server.

gravitypulse.warningThreshold.description: Battery percentage threshold below which the status bar turns Amber/Yellow.

gravitypulse.criticalThreshold.description: Battery percentage threshold below which the status bar turns Red with Low-Battery warning.

gravitypulse.infoThreshold.description: Battery percentage threshold below which an informational low-quota alert is triggered (Info tier).

gravitypulse.severeThreshold.description: Battery percentage threshold below which a severe low-quota alert is triggered (Severe tier).

gravitypulse.globalAlertCooldownMinutes.description: Global cooldown in minutes between low-quota and credits toast notifications across all sources.

gravitypulse.burnRateSampleCount.description: Number of rolling quota polling samples to maintain for burn-rate and time-to-empty calculations.

gravitypulse.creditsInfoThreshold.description: Available prompt credits percentage threshold below which an Info tier alert is triggered.

gravitypulse.creditsCriticalThreshold.description: Available prompt credits percentage threshold below which a Critical tier alert is triggered.

gravitypulse.creditsSevereThreshold.description: Available prompt credits percentage threshold below which a Severe tier alert is triggered.

gravitypulse.showToastOnLowCredits.description: Show notification alert toasts when available prompt credits drop below threshold (disabled by default to avoid alert spam).

gravitypulse.showToastOnLowBattery.description: Show a notification alert when battery drops below critical threshold.
